claim: Do not test carry after LDWS: boards with core 3.02.00 and 3.03.00 give it ADD D,1's flags (carry set when D was $FF); the book, JNext 1.3.0 and CSpect give INC D's (carry kept). ADD rr,A is settled: it clears carry.
limit: LDWS measured on two boards (3.02.00, 2026-10-21; N-Go board (Issue 2-compatible clone), core 3.03.00, nxsuite Z03), not on the book's 3.03.03. The LEARNINGS line on ADD rr,A keeping CF is about CSpect, not a board.

evidence.source: I. Novak, Unraveling the ZX Spectrum Next, Vol 1 (2026; core 3.03.03), chapter 2
evidence.text: ADD rr,A adds A unsigned, wraps past FFFF and clears carry even on a wrap, other flags kept; ADD rr,nn leaves every flag; LDWS takes the flags of INC D.
LDWS: flags of ADD D,1 (CF = D was $FF), not INC D's kept carry; ADD rr,A cleared CF (NEXT_REGISTERS.md:117).
N-Go board (Issue 2-compatible clone), core 3.03.00 (nxsuite Z03): LDWS with D = $7F and D = $FF left the flags of ADD D,1 ($94, then $51: carry set from $FF), not INC D's.
N-Go board (Issue 2-compatible clone), core 3.03.00 (nxsuite Z02): ADD rr,A cleared carry in all nine cases, a wrap past $FFFF included.
